none: PAS FindID 981205: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine, bent to scyphate form
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. A modified nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), probably a Vow in wreath issue of 320-325, Reece period 16. The flan has been bent to concavo-convex form with the obverse as the concave side, an operation which was presumably deliberately accomplished using heat and a rounded former.
